Philosophe d'Abdère. Tout est fait d'ato: Philosopher from Abdera. Everything is made of atoms and void.
Philosophe athénien. Son Jardin cherche: Athenian philosopher. His Garden sought simple pleasure and freedom from trouble.
Philosophe stoïcien et précepteur de Nér: Stoic philosopher and Nero's tutor. His Letters to Lucilius teach how to live well.
Empereur romain et stoïcien. Il écrit se: Roman emperor and Stoic. He wrote his Meditations for himself, on campaign.
Dominicain italien. Sa Somme théologique: Italian Dominican. His Summa Theologica reconciled Christian faith with Aristotle.
Philosophe d'Amsterdam, polisseur de len: Amsterdam philosopher and lens grinder. His Ethics is written like geometry.
Écrivain des Lumières. Il se bat contre: Enlightenment writer. He fought intolerance, from the Calas affair to Candide.
Philosophe écossais. Rien, dit-il, ne pr: Scottish philosopher. Nothing, he said, proves the sun will rise tomorrow.
Philosophe allemand. « Dieu est mort » :: German philosopher. 'God is dead': values must be reinvented.
